purpose: Define deterministic fallback when a requested translation is missing, while keeping fallback behavior visible and preventing silent substitution of machine identifiers as UI text.

topics.name: Localization Fallback
topics.purpose: Define deterministic fallback when a requested translation is missing, while keeping fallback behavior visible and preventing silent substitution of machine identifiers as UI text.

semantics.default_fallback: en where configured as UI fallback; exact deployment policy remains explicit
semantics.missing_rule: Missing translation is detectable and reportable.
semantics.identifier_rule: Canonical machine IDs/commands are not used as fallback UI text unless the UI explicitly requests raw identifier display.
semantics.trace_rule: Rendered localized value can report which fallback level produced it.
semantics.lock_rule: Required production localization completeness may be a release gate per product/deployment policy.

invariants.rule: Localization changes human-facing labels and explanatory text only; canonical identities, commands and machine semantics remain language-independent.

hard_gates.condition: canonical machine ID used as accidental user-facing translation
deployment claims complete localization while required entries are missing
